summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of VISITA appointment v2 workflow (slot-based requests, staff Offer flow, patient slot selection, admin availability config, notifications integration layer). Created new pytest module /app/backend/tests/test_appt_v2.py (16 tests, all passing) covering: /api/availability/slots shape+weekday+time bounds, patient slot-based POST with valid slots + rejections (empty options, Sunday, 09:00 out-of-hours), staff direct approve with valid + invalid time (400), offer -> patient select -> confirmed flow, select-when-not-offered 400, notifications (in-portal note created, medical reason NOT leaked), admin GET/PUT /api/admin/availability, staff 403 on both, admin enable Friday -> Friday slots appear, legacy 'suggest' action ignored. Frontend Playwright validated: patient Request page shows 3 preferred-option dropdowns (161 slot options from availability), appt-reason, appt-submit; staff appointment queue modal shows appt-approve, appt-offer, use-option-0/1/2, offer-selector opens, 'Suggest Another Time' string NOT present anywhere; admin Settings page shows availability-card with per-day toggles (mon-thu enabled, fri-sun disabled - matches DEFAULT_AVAILABILITY), avail-duration, settings-save; staff Hub counters still load (6 tiles); Portal My Requests loads. Regression: no page errors, all counters visible.

issues: Existing seed appointment APT-000001 (Maria) still shows patient-facing status pill 'New Time Suggested' (legacy 'suggested' status). New workflow uses 'alternatives_offered' -> 'Alternative Times Offered'. Legacy seed data was probably not fully migrated by seed.py app_meta 'appt_v2' guard. Non-blocking but should be verified after a full db reset.

action_items: OPTIONAL: verify seed migration converts any pre-existing status='suggested' appointments to 'alternatives_offered' (or drop from patient-facing list). Test observed APT-000001 for Maria still shows 'New Time Suggested' badge.

notifications.py never includes appt.reason in outbound_notifications subject/body — only confirmed_display (date/time). Good HIPAA-adjacent design.
outbound_notifications collection created with status='prepared' when enabled flag is False — integration-ready stub.
Google Calendar sync_calendar is a no-op stub as specified.
AppointmentQueue.jsx: legacy 'Suggest Another Time' fully removed; replaced by 'Offer Available Times' + slot selector. Confirmed via full-page HTML search.
PortalAppointments.jsx: dropdowns disabled while slot-query loading; Request Appointment button disabled when slots.length===0. Good UX.
Settings.jsx: availability-card exposes per-day enabled toggles + start/end + duration + vacations/closures/blocked_periods editors.
